_comment: Denied-path copy pack for voice room commands (create/join/move when denied). Each case is one observable denied outcome with the exact surface text the harness must surface distinctly, never as a generic failure. Sources are pinned in scripts/voice_denied_copy.py; this file carries shapes only. Offline only: no network, no tokens, no guild touch.
pack: voice-room denied-path copy: create/join/move permission denials

cases.name: create_member_denied

observation.reply: You need Manage Channels to use /create.
observation.reason: harness identity lacks Manage Channels; the bot itself is healthy

cases.meaning: Fix the harness identity's Discord permissions or test with an authorized identity; never a bot bug, never a watch-log error. Never retry with another credential.

cases.name: create_bot_denied

observation.reply: I cannot create channels here: I need Manage Channels. Tell an admin to fix my permissions.
observation.reason: Discord refused the channel create with 403; the bot role lacks Manage Channels

cases.meaning: Grant the staging bot Manage Channels on the guild or category, then rerun. Distinct from create_member_denied: the member was authorized, the bot was not.

cases.name: create_required_role

observation.reply: You need the server's required role to use voice-room commands.
observation.reason: guild access controls name a required role the harness identity lacks

cases.meaning: Guild-level gate, evaluated before any per-command restriction. Fix the harness identity's roles or lift the gate on the staging guild; not a Discord permission problem.

cases.name: create_command_restricted

observation.reply: You do not have a role that may use this command here.
observation.reason: guild access controls restrict the create command to roles the harness identity lacks

cases.meaning: Per-command gate. Distinct from create_required_role: the guild-wide role passed but this command's allow-list did not.

cases.name: join_not_occupant

observation.reply: Only room occupants can start a vote.
observation.reason: vote-kick initiator has not joined the temporary room

cases.meaning: Join-state denial on the kick path: the initiator must join the room first. Not a permission misconfiguration.

cases.name: join_not_a_room

observation.reply: That member is not in a temporary voice room.
observation.reason: vote-kick target is not in a tracked temporary room

cases.meaning: Join-state denial on the kick path: there is no room to act on. Check the target joined a creator channel first.

cases.name: join_not_in_room

observation.reply: You need to be in the room to use this command.
observation.reason: ownership command invoked by a member outside the room

cases.meaning: Join-state denial on the ownership path (reclaim/transfer): the actor must be in the room. Have the harness identity join first, then rerun.

cases.name: move_bot_denied

observation.reply: channel <#500>: Discord access denied; suspend until permissions change
observation.reason: Discord refused the member move with 403; the bot lacks Move Members on the room

cases.meaning: The move is a background queue action with no interaction reply: the denial surfaces as this /setup failure line and the matching logging notice. Grant the bot Move Members, then reconcile. The member stays in the creator channel; nothing is retried in a storm.

cases.name: generic_failure_contrast

observation.reply: Something went wrong (ref 1a2b3c4d). Please try again — if it keeps happening, share this reference with a server admin.
observation.reason: handler error with a correlation reference; the only text that ever carries a failure outward

cases.meaning: Contrast case: the one shape that IS a bot-side failure. None of the eight denied cases above may classify here, or a red smoke line becomes untriagable by shape.
